messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex I, Part B, point 14

14. Devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m.

response.text:
Devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods | areListedIn | REG Annex I, Part B, point 14 | involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height | "Devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m."
Person-lifting devices in scope | applyAboveFallHeight | more than 3 m vertical height | only where the device involves a hazard of falling | "involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m"
